skotiq_core/providers.reason: Linked halves handed to a class that does the work here and forwards it to the host otherwise. Data both sides keep belongs on a hostRoleProvider and is to be converted: planning (project, target constraint, integration goal, scheduler queue services and the candidate loader), dark library, defect maps, live stacking, calibration settings and transient alert settings/states. Host-only forwarding (device commands, files, imaging records, events, profiles, post-session, meridian flip) is the pattern skill section 3.8.2 describes. The count only goes down.
